top_refs.text:
- This screen shows in graphical form the evolution of consumption over the last 30 minutes.

- The average consumption of the current trip (Since start) can be compared with the average consumption displayed on the instrument panel (Since reset).

- The consumption data (Since reset) shown in the instrument panel and in this display can be reset to zero with a long press on the steering wheel.

- The average consumption of “Climate & others" takes into account climate and all other electrical consumers (specific to the electric vehicle).
